LESSON: HADITH ON:HONESTY

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITH the learner should be able to: “…..To worship Allah as if you see Him for
Topic 4.2: Hadith on:Honesty

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Hadith on:Honesty. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is honesty?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read the selected Hadith correctly.
2. Apply the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing piety.
3. Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith to inculcate the virtue. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Critical thinking and problem solving Learning to learn Citizenship

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Read the selected Hadith correctly.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read the selected Hadith correctly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Apply the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing piety.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing piety. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith to inculcate the virtue. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Critical thinking and problem solving Learning to learn Citizenship
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the teachings of the Hadith to inculcate the virtue. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Critical thinking and problem solving Learning to learn Citizenship. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadith on:Honesty.
2. Explain Hadith on:Honesty to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on:Honesty.
4. Show that you can: Read the selected Hadith correctly.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on:Honesty. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is honesty?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Read the selected Hadith correctly.
2. Apply the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing piety.
3. Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith to inculcate the virtue. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration Critical thinking and problem solving Learning to learn Citizenship

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
